title: New GTA6 Jason Artwork Revealed as Target Vinyl Exclusive Poster
description: A new GTA6 Jason artwork has surfaced on Reddit, reportedly featured as an exclusive poster for Target's vinyl album edition. Check out the latest community discovery.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## New GTA6 Jason Artwork Surfaces Online

As the hype surrounding Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster continues to build, the global gaming community remains on high alert for any new piece of official material. Recently, a fresh discovery shared by a user on the r/GTA6 Reddit community (u/yourfavchoom) has given fans something new to analyze: a brand-new artwork featuring the male protagonist, Jason, which is reportedly set to be included as an exclusive poster in Target's version of the GTA 6 vinyl album edition.

This finding has quickly garnered attention across various social media platforms, as fans eagerly comb through every available visual asset to learn more about Jason, Lucia, and the setting of Leonida. 

## The Appeal of Physical Soundtracks and Collectibles

While the full visual details of the newly revealed artwork continue to be discussed among community members, the inclusion of a vinyl record edition with an exclusive poster points toward the physical collector's market. Rockstar Games has a long-standing tradition of producing critically acclaimed soundtracks that define the atmosphere of their open-world epics. A dedicated vinyl release, especially with retailer-specific bonuses like a Target-exclusive poster, would be a major treat for physical media collectors and audiophiles alike.

It is important to note, however, that this information originates from a community source (unconfirmed rumor). Rockstar Games has not yet issued an official press release or confirmation regarding the vinyl edition or its exclusive poster content. Fans should keep this in mind and await official announcements from the studio.

## Editor's Take

Community-driven leaks and retailer listings often hint at the gradual ramp-up of a game's promotional campaign. While we must treat this unconfirmed report with cautious optimism, the prospect of a Target-exclusive vinyl and new Jason artwork highlights the immense anticipation surrounding GTA 6's merchandise rollout.
